title: ErrorCode
description: Structured, machine-readable error codes surfaced across every service boundary. This enum is the single canonical list; TypeScript and Python constants are verified against it by conformance tests. The codes are distinct because callers must react differently: PRECONDITION_MISMATCH means the scene moved under us and a human decision is needed; MUTATION_FAILED means the write itself failed and may be retried; VERIFY_FAILED means the write appeared to succeed but the scene disagrees and must be rolled back; OBJECT_NOT_MOVABLE means the target is locked or linked and no retry will help. UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION means the agent understood the request was a command but cannot interpret it — the user should rephrase, which is different from a malformed request. PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE means an AI provider is not configured or reachable, which is an operator problem rather than a user error.
